role: The fireball base: constant acceleration flight with drag, a block and entity ray hit with a 25-tick self-hit gate, the 600-tick stuck life, and being deflectable by a hit.
scope_reason: The base of the ghast's large fireball and the blaze's small fireball, both replayed.

members.name: EntityFireball
members.note: the bare constructor's 1.0 size is folded into the spawn helpers

members.name: EntityFireball
members.note: with the three 0.4 Gaussian aim draws

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: the shooter-dead and unloaded-chunk kills, the setFire(1), the stuck life, the ray hit, the drag and the smoke; the entity ray reaches the other pools through query_other (fireball-through-s1)

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: the direction list is the motion triple

members.name: readEntityFromNBT
members.note: a missing direction kills the fireball, as in vanilla; a fireball reloaded with its chunk (snapshot_entities.c sr_fireball_from_nbt) reads an unused inTile as air, as Block.getBlockById does (nether-fight-s1)

members.name: canBeCollidedWith
members.note: true; the client pick (pick.c) and the projectile lists (ie_can_be_collided_with)

members.name: getCollisionBorderSize
members.note: 1.0 in the client pick, so a fireball three blocks wide can be punched

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: the player's punch (pickobj.c, the look as a Vec3), another fireball's impact (ghasts.c); the onFire setBeenAttacked feeds the tracker's S12 when the damage lands, fire % 20 == 0: every tick at setFire(1)'s 20, every twentieth after lava's 300 (item_entity.c base_update, combat.c; sr4-bridge-s1); an arrow, snowball, egg or pearl hit is projectile.c proj_fireball_attack_from: setBeenAttacked, the motion and acceleration along the attacker's look, a living attacker becomes the shooter (fireball-deflect-s42)

notes: The large and small subclasses' impact code lives in ghasts.c and projectile.c respectively; this record covers the shared flight, NBT and deflect behaviour. The abstract onImpact is n/a, not missing. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the bare constructor is only the NBT/client path. Formerly listed as missing: The bare (World) constructor has no standalone native; the spawn helpers cover the two forms the game uses.
